chat:
User: build me an app to track my expenses
AI: Sure! I'll set up a simple expense tracker with React and a small Express server. Here is the code...
User: it's not working
AI: Could you tell me what is happening? An error message or what you expected would help.
User: the page is blank. fix it
AI: A blank page often means a JavaScript error. Please open the browser console and share what it says.
User: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
AI: That is a lot at once. Let's fix the blank page first, then add features one by one.
User: now it shows but when I add an expense and refresh it's gone
AI: The data lives in memory, so a refresh loses it. You need to store it somewhere permanent.
User: ok add a database

does not explain how to reproduce

items.excerpt: build me an app to track my expenses
items.why: No stack, features, or goal are given, so the AI must guess the whole design.
items.rewrite: Build an expense tracker using [React/Express/etc]. It should let me add, view, and delete expenses.

items.why: There is no description of what fails, what was tried, or where the code lives.
items.rewrite: The app fails at [step]. I changed [file] at [lines]. Expected [X], got [Y].

items.excerpt: the page is blank. fix it
items.why: A blank screen can come from many causes; without the console error the AI cannot target the fix.

items.excerpt: idk how. just make it work and also add charts and login and dark mode
items.why: Bundling a blank-page fix with charts, login, and dark mode makes it impossible to test or review one change at a time.
items.rewrite: First fix the blank page. After that works, add charts as a separate task.
